description: As step-order-tag-term-after-conditions-check, with the failing tag term in the definition's `%tags` rather than the alternative's own. A `$` condition that fails without reading `tags($)` stops both tag terms (engine §4, §3.7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (A [+T])
%rule b (A [+T] [+T])
%rule c (A x)
%rule x :: $.tokens-after-first.tags(migration-fault) | T %conditions $.source-text = "q"


%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
